literal: with loving nature desiring they will be by intimacy without asking friends if do
translation: If friends do something without asking out of intimacy, true friends will gladly accept it with a loving heart.
modern: நண்பர்கள் உரிமையோடு கேட்காமலேயே ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், அதனை அன்போடு விரும்பி ஏற்றுக்கொள்வார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains how true friends react when their companions take liberties. If a friend does something on their behalf without asking for permission, relying on their close intimacy, the other will not be offended. Instead, they will gladly accept and appreciate the action because of their deeply loving nature. The word 'கெழுதகை' highlights the rightful familiarity that true friendship grants.
